blocks.text: Hatzic homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Hatzic, September 2026. Detached houses: 20 listed at month end and 3 sold in September, a sales ratio of 15% (a balanced market). No condos and townhomes were listed or sold in Hatzic between June and September.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 15 sold over 4 months against an average of 21.0 listed, about 5.6 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 7 sold.

faq.a: Partly. The Hatzic Bench is inside the City of Mission, but Hatzic Prairie is Fraser Valley Regional District Electoral Area F and Hatzic Island is Electoral Area G — the FVRD's housing-needs report lists Area F as "McConnell Creek, Hatzic Prairie" and Area G as "Nicomen Island, Deroche, Dewdney, Hatzic Island" — and all of it carries Mission mailing addresses and sits in the board's Hatzic sub-area.

faq.q: How did Hatzic sell in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached recorded 20 listings with 3 sold (a 15% sales ratio, the second-highest published detached ratio in Mission that month, on a small count of 3 sales), and Condos & Townhomes recorded 0 listings and 0 sold, so no attached ratio exists; no sub-area median is published for Hatzic, and the Mission community medians (detached $814,000; attached $430,000) are board context, not Hatzic figures (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Who do I pay property tax to on a Hatzic property?
faq.a: It depends on which Hatzic: Bench properties inside the City of Mission pay the City (2026 taxes due July 2, 2026, 10% penalty July 3); Hatzic Prairie and Hatzic Island properties are rural — their owners receive the notice from the Province's Surveyor of Taxes Office and pay the Province, with rural taxes due July 2 and 5% + 5% penalties under the Taxation (Rural Area) Act.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Hatzic?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 20 houses listed with 3 sold in the month in Hatzic. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Hatzic a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 15%, a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
